text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen to look outside the window and
notice
Agnes Digital running in the rain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Here I go! One more laaap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thirty minutes later, while I'm walking
down the
hallway...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was a good run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you... Uehehe! Of course you'd think that, noob! Little do you know, I was out there because it was raining! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The weather forecast says it's going to
rain during
my race, so I figured I should
practice under the
same conditions!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The weather forecast says it's going to
rain during
my race, so I figured I should
practice under the
same conditions!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, tsk! I'm no hothouse flower! ♪ No
rain,
beat-up tracks, or cold's gonna
stop my burning
passion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And come rain or shine, my next race is
still on
dirt, so I've got nothing to lose
from practicing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Guehehe! I'd sooner die than miss out on
the best
moment in a race, no matter
what kind of dirt
track I'm running on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital does have a point.
Training in poor
conditions makes it
easier to adapt to all kinds of
situations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But of course! I don't ever wanna cut
corners!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gleaming eyes are full of passion.
With such
an unwavering drive to win,
she's an exemplary
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I strive to capture
every
glimpse of lovely perfection with
my eyes no
matter how poor the
conditions! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The sight of Umas running in the rain,
their hearts
connected with burning
emotions and their
sweaty forms
splattered with mud...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooah! It's the heaviest of heavy
romances,
playing out on the drenched
racetrack! My
mouth's watering just
thinking about it! ♪
